player_prompt.intro:
I bɛ jɛlɛ 2048 kɔnɔ {board_size}x{board_size} tablo la. I lakali ni {target_tile} bɛɛ bɔ kɔnɔ ka bɛɛ kɛlɛɛ kɔnɔfɛnw ta ka tɛmɛnɛnɛ!
Kɛlɛɛ dɔw: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Bɛɛ bɔ kɔnɔfɛnw bɛ kɛlɛɛ kɔnɔ ka tɛmɛnɛnɛ, ka bɛɛ kɛlɛɛ kɔnɔfɛnw dɔbɔra.

invalid_move.no_change: O ma yɛlɛma, nka u ye sira wɛrɛ ta.

outcome.win: Aw ka tɔgɔ, i ka {target_tile}! Sikoro kɛnɛ {score}.
outcome.lose: I ka tuguni dɔ. Tile dɛmɛn {max_tile} - sikoro kɛnɛ {score}.
